primary_outcome: the statements printed by /app/tools/hail_run.py give every field's stand loss, defoliation, leaf loss, loss, payable loss, indemnity, replant line and payment, and every claim's total and paid amount, as the Crop-Hail Loss Adjustment Procedure edition 7 gives them

obligations.contribution: stand loss and defoliation are averaged over all of a field's plots

separability.rationale: the averages make the field loss

obligations.discriminating_instance: fields mixing plots with no plant lost and no leaf damage beside damaged plots
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: divide by the plots with a figure above nought (shipped)
obligations.selfdescription_phrase: averaged over all of a field's plots

obligations.contribution: a hail-thinned plot's stand loss is its dead and broken plants over its stand; a plot that is not hail-thinned keeps today's figure (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: The stand loss of a hail-thinned plot is its dead and broken plants

separability.rationale: stand-loss figures make the field stand loss

obligations.discriminating_instance: plots with exactly one plant in ten lost; plots losing fewer, with figures below 5.0, 5.0-7.9 and 8.0-9.9 per cent
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: editing the shared trace_tenths entry to 80 for 5.1; nought for plots that are not hail-thinned; the plain share with no trace step

obligations.contribution: leaf loss is the growth stage's chart percentage of the field's defoliation

authority.anchor: defoliation times the percentage the leaf-loss

separability.rationale: leaf loss makes the field loss

obligations.discriminating_instance: R4 fields with defoliation, and every stage at 100 per cent defoliation

obligations.contribution: a field's loss is its stand loss plus its leaf loss as a share of what the stand loss leaves

authority.anchor: Leaf loss falls only on the plants the storm left standing

separability.rationale: the loss decides the payable loss

obligations.discriminating_instance: fields with both stand and leaf loss; a whole stand lost
obligations.selfdescription_phrase: share of what the stand loss leaves

obligations.contribution: a field whose loss is below 8.0 per cent has a payable loss of nought

authority.anchor: A field whose loss is below 8.0 per cent

separability.rationale: the payable loss makes the indemnity

obligations.discriminating_instance: losses of 5.0 to 7.9 per cent and exactly 8.0

obligations.contribution: straight: loss less 10.0 per cent, not below nought; vanishing: twice the excess over 20.0 per cent, not below nought, never more than the loss

authority.anchor: Under `straight` it is the loss less 10.0 per cent

separability.rationale: the payable loss makes the indemnity

obligations.discriminating_instance: straight fields from 8.0 to 15.0 per cent; vanishing fields around 20.0 and 40.0 per cent and above

obligations.contribution: the payable loss taken as a share of the liability, rounded to the cent, half up

authority.anchor: A field's indemnity is its liability times its payable loss

separability.rationale: the indemnity makes the field payment

obligations.discriminating_instance: odd amounts per acre and acres leaving every remainder, exact halves included

obligations.contribution: a replanted field (10.0 acres or more) earns 3,000 cents an acre replanted; a smaller replanting keeps today's line (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: A replanted field earns a replant payment of 3,000 cents

separability.rationale: the replant line makes the field payment

obligations.discriminating_instance: replantings of exactly 10.0 acres and of 0.1 to 9.9 acres priced below 2,500 and from 2,500 to 9,999 cents
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: editing the shared small_cents entry to 10,000 for 7.2; nothing for replantings under 10.0 acres; no trace step

obligations.contribution: a claim's total is its field payments; paid in full at 10,000 cents or more, otherwise not paid

authority.anchor: A claim whose total is 10,000 cents or more is paid in full

separability.rationale: the primary outcome's total and paid

obligations.discriminating_instance: claim totals of 2,500 to 9,999 cents, exactly 10,000 and 9,999
